'''Ut''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Ut system/Legends|Ut system]] of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]. It provided a song to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] when the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] sent a diplomatic envoy to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].

==Description==
The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Ut was located in the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]],<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref><ref name="CEU">{{CSWECite|III|283|Ut}}</ref> in one of four distinct regions of the Cluster, the [[Interior Region]],<ref name="EA" /> which was considered the heart of the entire Cluster.<ref name="CEHC">{{CSWECite|II|16|Hapes Cluster}}</ref> Besides [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], [[Thrakia]], [[Selab]], and [[Gallinore]], there were roughly twenty other worlds throughout the region.<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref> The [[Ut system/Legends|Ut star system]] was connected by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] to the capital world of Hapes and the [[Harterra system/Legends|Harterra system]].<ref name="EA" />

==History==
===Formation of the Hapes Consortium===
The [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]] was a grouping of sixty-three [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CEHCS">{{CSWECite|II|16|Hapes Consortium}}</ref> and at least 119 known worlds within the cluster's boundaries.<ref name="CEHC" /> It was surrounded by vast drifts of [[Gas/Legends|gas]] and ionized particles known as the [[Transitory Mists]], which made hyperspace travel all but impossible except for a few carefully guarded routes into the cluster.<ref name="EA" />

[[File:Interior_Region.png|left|thumb|260px|The Interior Region of the Hapes Cluster, where the planet Ut was located]]
Beginning around [[4200 BBY]],<ref name="EA" /> the Hapes Cluster was originally settled by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] called the [[Lorell Raiders]],<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="SWE" /> who turned it into a haven for themselves,<ref name="CTD" /><ref name="EA" /> forming bases and storing their ill-gotten gains.<ref name="CTD" /> When the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Battle of Lorell|wiped out]] the Lorell Raiders, the worlds of Hapes were forgotten for a time,<ref name="CPL" /> but the women of the Hapes Cluster established a matriarchal society marked by near-constant palace intrigues and assassinations.<ref name="EA" /> The center of the Cluster, the [[Interior Region]], was the first region conquered and controlled by the line of [[Hapan Royal House|hereditary matriarchs]] known as the [[Queen Mother]]s.<ref name="CTD" /> Later, the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]], ruled by the Queen Mothers, colonized sixty-three worlds within the Cluster, though perhaps twice that number were thought to be habitable.<ref name="EA" />

===Hapan world===
Each member system had a vote in all matters of state, but the Queen Mother could break a tie.<ref name="CEHCS" /> The planet Ut,<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="EA" /> like the capital world of [[Hapes/Legends|Hapes]], was situated at the center of the [[Interior Region]],<ref name="EA" /> considered the heart of the cluster,<ref name="CEHC" /> where the houses of the eldest and dominant Hapan worlds were resided.<ref name="EA" />

[[File:Hapans-GOI.jpg|right|thumb|250px|The Hapan people lived in the worlds of the Hapes Cluster]]
Circa [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]], a unique transport vessel, the ''[[Star Home]]'', was designed for the exclusive use of the Hapan Queen Mother. To the matriarchal Hapan people, this ornate vessel represented wealth, power, and the supreme authority of the Queen Mother. The wind-sculpted [[Basalt/Legends|basalt]] was carved from the surface of Hapes itself, while the [[Stone/Legends|stone]] for the [[Castle/Legends|castle]] was quarried from the [[Moon/Legends|moons]] orbiting Hapes. The [[Crystal/Legends|crystal]] for the domes came from [[Selab]], while each of the other sixty-one inhabited worlds of the Hapes Cluster contributed stone, woodwork, gems, or other ornamentation for the interior. Each year, the governor of each world presented the most treasured artifact from their planet to be stored forever in the galleries and vaults of the ''Star Home''. Honored visitors could view treasures of the Hapan people dating back over four millennia, including the first great epic poems of the Hapan [[Privateer/Legends|privateers]], the incredible [[sonic-crystal sculpture]]s of [[Gallinore]], and the latest works of the great scientist [[Mont'Kar'oh]] from the technology world of [[Charubah]].<ref name="EGV">''[[The Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''</ref>

Around [[3100 BBY]],<ref name="CEHCS" /><ref name="EA" /> the [[Isolationist Queen Mother|reigning Queen Mother]] closed the borders of the Hapes Cluster to outsiders, and it remained isolated for [[Millennium/Legends|millennia]].<ref name="CEHCS" /> Despite its proximity to one of the galaxy's greatest hyperlanes, the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], this knot of ancient worlds remained stubbornly apart from [[Galactic community|galactic civilization]] and soon became a virtual legend in the galaxy they had left behind: spacer tales told of the Hapans' beauty, immense riches, terrible warships, and cruelty.<ref name="EA" />

For more than 3,000 years, the [[Hapan]] people of the Consortium<ref name="SWE" /> lived on high-tech worlds<ref name="CPL" /> and remained a very wealthy society, encompassing hundreds of governments and thousands of cultures.<ref name="SWE" /> The [[Hapan Home Fleet|fleet]] of [[Hapan Battle Dragon]]s was primarily responsible for the security of the Cluster, protecting the planet Hapes and the surrounding area of space.<ref name="CEHHF">{{CSWECite|II|15|Hapan Home Fleet}}</ref> They were painted to represent each of the sixth-three [[Star/Legends|stars]]<ref name="CEHBD">{{CSWECite|II|15|Hapan Battle Dragon}}</ref> and their inhabited planets in the Hapes Cluster.<ref name="CPL" />

===End of the isolation===
[[8 ABY/Legends|Four years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="SWE" /><ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Queen Mother [[Ta'a Chume]], matriarch of the Royal House of Hapes, broke the Cluster's long isolation. As part of a series of gifts from each of the sixty-three worlds of the Hapes Consortium to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="CPL" /> the planet Ut sent a [[Gender/Legends|woman]] to sing a beautiful song.<ref name="CPL" /><ref name="SWE" /><ref name="CEU" />

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the planet Ut was represented in the Hapes Consortium by a female delegate. She was among the other representatives of the Hapes Consortium's worlds in the [[Lorell Hall]] on Hapes when New Republic Ambassador [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] arrived to solicit aid in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War|struggle]] against the powerful [[Yuuzhan Vong|invaders]].<ref name="NJO">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Ut was introduced in the novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'',<ref name="CPL" /> which was written by [[Dave Wolverton]] and released in [[1994]].<ref name="ERC" /> Later, ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], presented a detailed depiction of the Hapes Cluster.<ref name="EA" />
